title: Roadmap Schema Validation + Prior-Failures YAML Linter (MANDATORY INFRASTRUCTURE)

linter_run_next_roadmap.note: research-roadmap-next.yaml does not exist (current milestone .80 is active and not yet swapped). Linter on this path returns a single 'File not found' schema error; this is expected steady-state behaviour and not a violation of the .80 roadmap content itself.

fail_open_decision.rationale: Schema validation logs warnings via _warn_if_roadmap_invalid() at all three conductor wiring sites; the conductor never blocks on a schema warning during .80. This is intentional rollout discipline: collect a milestone of warnings to confirm no false positives before flipping to fail-closed in .81.

addressed_recurring_failure.mechanism: Linter scans every task title against archived experiment titles; flags tasks with >=3 token overlap that lack prior_failures. Planner can run linter pre-commit to self-check; conductor warns at activation/load/pick time.

known_constraints: Token-overlap heuristic uses a stopword list to suppress recurring task categories (preflight, retrospective, manifest, etc.). Future planners that introduce a genuinely new recurring category will need the stopword list updated.
Fail-open mode means the .80 milestone will still launch malformed roadmaps; the warning surfaces in conductor logs but does not block. Flip-to-fail-closed deferred to .81 per planned rollout.
